text:
jen (Marketing): Quick heads-up — we need to change the syndication list for tomorrow's benchmark story. Legal flagged a line in the press kit; delaying syndication asks until cleared.

sam (PR): Ack. Which outlets do we hold back from syndication?

tess (Legal): Please hold syndication to syndicates and non-US outlets (APAC syndication partners) until we confirm partner approvals. US direct outreach is fine.

maya (Growth): That impacts our scheduled reposts on partner channels at 11:00 PT. I'll pause the repost workflow.

drew (Design): If logos need removing we'll push a quick visual update. Can do an alternate press card without logos; will upload in 20m.

jen (Marketing): Good. Sam, send embargo to reporters as planned at 09:55 PT, but add a short note: "Syndication restricted until partner approvals are finalized."

sam (PR): Drafting; will include an extra line at the top and mark attachments with "No syndication" watermark for affected files.

alfred (Product): Product ok to proceed with technical Q&A. We should prep one-liner about measurement methodology to avoid ambiguity.

nora (Support): I'll make a 3-bullet FAQ for support quick replies: 1) measurement baseline, 2) how customers see changes, 3) where to report anomalies.

jen (Marketing): Nice. Also: deploy-bot will run the preview at 09:58 PT. Please check the canonical link and OG tags during preview.

deploy-bot: preview: staging.redwood.io/cost-playbook available at 09:58 PT. Run checks for OG, canonical, and image sizes.

sam (PR): One more ask — if partner approvals come through before 10:30 PT, we'll send a syndication follow-up. Otherwise, we'll roll without syndication.

tess (Legal): I'll expedite approvals; target is 10:15 PT. If we can't get sign-off, refrain from syndicating.

maya (Growth): Paused paid syndication queues until flag cleared. Will revert by flag or message here.

jen (Marketing): Timeline recap: 09:55 PT embargo to reporters (US ok), 09:58 PT preview checks, 10:00 PT publish, 10:15 PT syndication decision window. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

drew (Design): Uploaded logo-free cards: https://drive.redwood/launch/alt-cards

nora (Support): FAQ uploaded to press kit.

jen (Marketing): Great. I'll notify exec comms of the syndication hold and update the company note at 09:30 PT.

sam (PR): Sending embargo now to approved list, excluding syndication partners.

jen (Marketing): update the thread when approvals land.
